how.ar: قسم شؤون الأسرة وقواعد اختصاصه الإقليمي ودور النيابة العامة طرفا أصليا ورئيس القسم قاضيا للاستعجال تسري كما هي على دعوى الطلاق؛ تستورد عباراتها ولا تعاد كتابتها هنا، ويكتب هذا السجل قاعدة القسم الخاصة به.
how.en: The family section, its territorial rules, the public prosecutor as a principal party and the section president as urgent-matters judge apply as they are to a divorce petition; they are imported and not rewritten here, and this record writes its own section rule.

checklist.item: Is the marriage valid and proved by a civil-status record or a judgment of proof of marriage?
checklist.note: The marriage is proved by an extract of the civil-status register, or by a judgment when it was not registered.

checklist.item: Is the plaintiff the husband acting by his own will, and not the wife (tatliq or khul)?
checklist.note: The text lists three modes of divorce; tatliq and khul belong to the wife.

checklist.item: Which section of the court hears family matters, and does this court have a family section?
checklist.note: Family section; civil section where the court has no sections.

checklist.item: Which court has territorial jurisdiction for a husband's divorce petition (the family home, the place of the wife, the residence of the custodian)?
checklist.note: The court of the marital home; neither the wife's residence nor the custodian's place is the rule for divorce itself.

checklist.item: Is the territorial rule of public order, and can the parties agree otherwise?
checklist.note: The text makes the rule exclusive and says the plea of territorial incompetence is raised before any defence on the merits; it does not say the court raises it of its own motion.

checklist.item: Is a divorce, tatliq or khul action already pending between the spouses?
checklist.note: Unity of subject and connexity rules; whether a wife's action is the same dispute is a reading.

checklist.item: Must the petition state the elements required of every petition (court, parties, facts, requests, documents)?
checklist.note: Formal inadmissibility is the sanction stated for the listed elements.

checklist.item: Is a prior conciliation attempt by the judge required, in how many sessions and within what period?
checklist.note: The attempts are mandatory but are made by the judge after filing; no step is required of the lawyer before filing, so no prior step is written.

checklist.item: What is the maximum period for the conciliation attempts, and may the judge extend it?
checklist.note: Three months from filing in all cases; a reflection period may be granted inside it.

checklist.item: Must the spouses appear in person at the conciliation session, and what if one is absent?
checklist.note: Each spouse is heard separately then together; an absent spouse personally served without excuse gives a record; the merits are then argued.

checklist.item: Does the judge record the conciliation attempt in a record, and what does its absence cost?
checklist.note: A signed record of the attempts and their results is required; no text read states a sanction for its absence.

checklist.item: Is the husband's divorce subject to any period of limitation or forfeiture?
checklist.note: No limitation or forfeiture binding the husband was found in the articles read (family code 47 to 72, procedure code 423 to 453, and the imported module); the three-month ceiling binds the judge's conciliation attempts, not the filing.

checklist.item: Is the public prosecutor a principal party to the case, and must the file be communicated to him?
checklist.note: A copy of the petition is served on the defendant and on the prosecutor.

checklist.item: What must the judge decide on the accessory consequences: custody, maintenance, visitation, housing, compensation of the wife?
checklist.note: Visitation must accompany any award of custody; compensation for abuse and provisional measures are ordered by the judge; housing duty is the father's (module statement not imported, since the husband does not claim it).

checklist.item: Does the husband's divorce expose him to compensation for arbitrary divorce, and is it asked for by the wife?
checklist.note: The judge who finds an abuse awards the divorced wife compensation; the text does not say the wife must ask.

checklist.item: Can the husband ask for visitation rights over the children, and from which court?
checklist.note: Visitation claims are heard by the family section; the territory for them is where custody is exercised.

checklist.item: Who holds custody and has the husband a right to see the children while custody is held by the mother?
checklist.note: The mother is first in the order of entitlement, then the father; the judge awarding custody awards visitation.

checklist.item: Which documents must be attached: marriage certificate, family record book, children's birth certificates, proof of residence?
checklist.note: The family record and birth extracts are required by the text only for the mutual-consent petition; their use here is a reading.

checklist.item: Must the petition state the children, their ages and their custodian?
checklist.note: The text requires the number of minor children only in the mutual-consent petition; stating them here is a protective reading.

checklist.item: Is the judgment of divorce appealable and in which respects (the principle of divorce, the accessory effects)?
checklist.note: Divorce judgments are not appealable except in their material aspects; custody judgments are appealable.

checklist.item: Is the judgment of divorce executed provisionally as to the accessory effects?
checklist.note: Only the non-suspensive effect of the cassation appeal and the provisional measures by order on petition were found; no text on provisional execution of the accessory effects was found.

checklist.item: Must the divorce judgment be transcribed in the civil-status register, and by whom?
checklist.note: Transcription is obligatory, at the care of the prosecutor.

checklist.item: Does the wife's waiting period (idda) matter for the claims, and from what date does it run?
checklist.note: Family code 58, 60 and 61 fix the waiting period after the divorce; none makes it a condition of the petition or a request of the husband, so none is cited.

checklist.item: Is the wife in a pregnancy or in a state that affects the claim?
checklist.note: No text read makes pregnancy a bar to filing or a rule of the petition; it only fixes the end of the waiting period (family code 60).

checklist.item: What proof is needed for the marriage and for the husband's will to divorce?
checklist.note: Marriage by civil-status extract or judgment; the judge verifies the husband's will.

checklist.item: Do the exits from the ordinary courts (administrative, commercial) apply to a family matter?
checklist.note: The family section of the ordinary court hears divorce; no exit of the ordinary-court-exits module is written for it and no text read sends divorce elsewhere.

checklist.item: Is a formal notice or a payment order relevant to a divorce petition?
checklist.note: No text read requires a formal notice or allows a payment order for divorce; the formal-notice module is not imported.

checklist.item: Are the fees of the petition due and who bears the costs?
checklist.note: The petition is registered only after the fees fixed by law are paid; the amount is not in the store (see the request lines).

checklist.item: Is the defendant wife resident abroad, and how is she served in that case?
checklist.note: At least twenty days between service and the first hearing; three months for a person residing abroad.

checklist.item: May the judge hear the matter in camera (closed session)?
checklist.note: The conciliation attempts are held in a closed session.

checklist.item: What happens to the dowry and to the household goods on divorce?
checklist.note: They are separate actions with their own territorial rules (court-sections.b55), not requests of this petition.

checklist.item: What does the store's note on the family-code articles raise (the current snapshot is checked; historical applicability is not certified)?
checklist.note: The cited articles are the current text; whether they governed on the date of the marriage or of the facts is not certified, so every statement keeps a protective reading.

checklist.item: How is the transcription of the divorce judgment in the civil-status register made?
checklist.note: Searched the store for the civil-status law: the store carries the family code and the procedure code only; the family code states the duty and the prosecutor's role (b4) but not the manner.

says.ar: يحل عقد الزواج بالطلاق الذي يتم بإرادة الزوج أو بتراضي الزوجين أو بطلب الزوجة في الحالات المحددة.
says.en: Marriage is dissolved by divorce, which takes place by the husband's will, by mutual consent, or at the wife's request in the cases fixed.

says.ar: لا يثبت الطلاق إلا بحكم بعد عدة محاولات صلح يجريها القاضي في مدة لا تتجاوز ثلاثة أشهر من رفع الدعوى.
says.en: Divorce is established only by judgment after several conciliation attempts by the judge, within three months of the filing of the claim.

says.ar: يحرر القاضي محضرا بمساعي ونتائج محاولات الصلح، يوقعه مع كاتب الضبط والطرفين.
says.en: The judge draws up a record of the attempts and their results, signed with the clerk and the parties.

says.ar: تسجل أحكام الطلاق وجوبا في الحالة المدنية بسعي من النيابة العامة.
says.en: Divorce judgments must be registered in the civil status at the instance of the public prosecutor.

says.ar: إذا تبين للقاضي تعسف الزوج في الطلاق حكم للمطلقة بالتعويض عن الضرر اللاحق بها.
says.en: If the judge finds that the husband abused divorce, he awards the divorced wife compensation for her harm.

says.ar: أحكام الطلاق والتطليق والخلع غير قابلة للاستئناف إلا في جوانبها المادية، وأحكام الحضانة قابلة للاستئناف.
says.en: Judgments of divorce, tatliq and khul are not appealable except in their material aspects; custody judgments are appealable.

says.ar: يجوز للقاضي أن يفصل استعجاليا بأمر على عريضة في التدابير المؤقتة كالنفقة والحضانة والزيارة والمسكن.
says.en: The judge may rule urgently by order on petition on provisional measures such as maintenance, custody, visitation and housing.

says.ar: تؤول الحضانة أولا إلى الأم ثم إلى الأب ثم إلى بقية المستحقين، وعلى القاضي إذا أسند الحضانة أن يحكم بحق الزيارة.
says.en: Custody goes first to the mother, then to the father, then to the other persons in order, and the judge who awards custody must award visitation.

says.ar: يثبت الزواج بمستخرج من سجل الحالة المدنية، وإن لم يسجل فبحكم قضائي.
says.en: Marriage is proved by an extract of the civil-status register, and, if it was not registered, by a judgment.

says.ar: ترفع دعوى الطلاق من أحد الزوجين أمام قسم شؤون الأسرة بعريضة وفق الأشكال المقررة لرفع الدعوى.
says.en: A divorce claim by one spouse is brought before the family section by a petition in the usual form for filing a claim.

says.ar: إذا كان الزوج ناقص الأهلية قدم الطلب باسمه وليه أو مقدمه.
says.en: Where the spouse lacks full capacity, the request is made in his name by his guardian or curator.

says.ar: على المدعي في دعوى الطلاق أن يبلغ رسميا المدعى عليه والنيابة العامة بنسخة من العريضة.
says.en: The plaintiff in a divorce claim must formally serve the defendant and the public prosecutor with a copy of the petition.

says.ar: يجوز له أيضا تبليغ النيابة العامة عن طريق أمانة الضبط.
says.en: He may also notify the public prosecutor through the registry.

says.ar: محاولات الصلح وجوبية وتتم في جلسة سرية.
says.en: The conciliation attempts are mandatory and held in a closed session.

says.ar: يستمع القاضي إلى كل زوج على انفراد ثم معا في التاريخ المحدد.
says.en: On the fixed date the judge hears each spouse separately, then together.

says.ar: إذا تخلف أحد الزوجين عن جلسة الصلح بدون عذر رغم تبليغه شخصيا حرر القاضي محضرا بذلك.
says.en: If a spouse, personally served, does not attend the conciliation hearing without excuse, the judge draws up a record of it.

says.ar: يجوز للقاضي منح الزوجين مهلة تفكير ومحاولة صلح جديدة واتخاذ التدابير المؤقتة بأمر غير قابل لأي طعن.
says.en: The judge may grant a reflection period for a new attempt and order provisional measures by an order open to no appeal.

says.ar: لا يجوز أن تتجاوز محاولات الصلح ثلاثة أشهر من تاريخ رفع دعوى الطلاق.
says.en: The conciliation attempts may not exceed three months from the filing of the divorce claim.

says.ar: عند عدم الصلح أو تخلف أحد الزوجين رغم المهلة تناقش موضوع الدعوى.
says.en: Where there is no conciliation, or a spouse is absent despite the reflection period, the merits are argued.

says.ar: يتأكد القاضي من إرادة الزوج في طلب الطلاق ويأمر بما يراه لازما من تدابير.
says.en: The judge makes sure of the husband's will to ask for divorce and orders whatever measures he finds necessary.

says.ar: الطعن بالنقض لا يوقف تنفيذ أحكام الطلاق.
says.en: An appeal in cassation does not suspend the execution of divorce judgments.

says.ar: ترفع دعاوى الطلاق أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرتها مسكن الزوجية دون سواها.
says.en: Divorce claims are brought before the court of the marital home and no other.

says.ar: يجب إثارة الدفع بعدم الاختصاص الإقليمي قبل أي دفاع في الموضوع أو دفع بعدم القبول.
says.en: The plea of territorial incompetence must be raised before any defence on the merits or plea of inadmissibility.

says.ar: ترفع الدعوى بعريضة مكتوبة موقعة ومؤرخة تودع بأمانة الضبط بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف.
says.en: A claim is brought by a written, signed and dated petition lodged at the registry in as many copies as there are parties.

says.ar: تتضمن العريضة تحت طائلة عدم القبول شكلا الجهة القضائية وبيانات الطرفين وعرضا موجزا للوقائع والطلبات والوسائل والمستندات.
says.en: On pain of formal inadmissibility the petition states the court, the parties' details, a short account of the facts, requests and grounds, and the supporting documents.

says.ar: يجب احترام أجل عشرين يوما على الأقل بين تسليم التكليف بالحضور والجلسة الأولى، ويمدد إلى ثلاثة أشهر إذا كان المكلف مقيما في الخارج.
says.en: At least twenty days must separate the delivery of the summons and the first hearing, extended to three months if the person summoned lives abroad.

says.ar: لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
says.en: The petition is registered only after the fees fixed by law are paid, unless the law says otherwise.

says.ar: لا يجوز التقاضي ما لم تكن للشخص صفة ومصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون.
says.en: No one may sue unless he has standing and a present or possible interest recognised by law.

says.ar: للزوجة أن تطلب التطليق للأسباب المعددة.
says.en: The wife may ask for tatliq on the causes listed.

says.ar: يجوز للزوجة دون موافقة الزوج أن تخالع نفسها بمقابل مالي.
says.en: The wife may, without the husband's consent, release herself by khul for a payment.

says.ar: من راجع زوجته بعد الحكم بالطلاق يحتاج إلى عقد جديد.
says.en: A man who takes back his wife after the divorce judgment needs a new contract.

says.ar: تقوم وحدة الموضوع عندما يرفع نفس النزاع إلى جهتين قضائيتين مختصتين ومن نفس الدرجة.
says.en: Unity of subject exists when the same dispute is brought before two competent courts of the same degree.

says.ar: تتخلى الجهة القضائية الأخيرة لصالح الأخرى إذا طلب أحد الخصوم ذلك، ويجوز للقاضي التخلي تلقائيا.
says.en: The later court must give up the case in favour of the other if a party asks, and the judge may do so of his own motion.

says.ar: تقوم حالة الارتباط عند وجود علاقة بين قضايا أمام تشكيلات أو جهات مختلفة تستلزم النظر فيها معا.
says.en: Connexity exists when cases before different formations or courts are so related that they should be heard together.

says.ar: الطلاق بالتراضي إجراء يرمي إلى حل الرابطة الزوجية بإرادة الزوجين المشتركة.
says.en: Divorce by mutual consent is a procedure to dissolve the marriage by the spouses' joint will.

says.ar: عند نشوز أحد الزوجين يحكم القاضي بالطلاق وبالتعويض للطرف المتضرر.
says.en: On the recalcitrance of one spouse the judge pronounces divorce and awards compensation to the injured party.

toProve.en: That the marriage was concluded between the parties

factsToState.ar: تاريخ ومكان عقد الزواج ورقم تسجيله في الحالة المدنية
factsToState.en: The date and place of the marriage and its civil-status registration number

note.ar: مستخرج من سجل الحالة المدنية إن كان الزواج مسجلا.
note.en: An extract of the civil-status register where the marriage is registered.

note.ar: حكم قضائي إن لم يكن الزواج مسجلا.
note.en: A judgment where the marriage was not registered.

toProve.ar: أن الزوج هو الذي يطلب الطلاق بإرادته المنفردة
toProve.en: That the husband himself asks for the divorce by his own will

factsToState.ar: أن الطلب صادر عن الزوج وأنه متمسك به
factsToState.en: That the request comes from the husband and that he maintains it

proof.means: the husband's petition and his statement before the judge

note.en: The judge makes sure of the husband's will.

toProve.ar: وجود الأولاد القصر ومن تؤول إليه حضانتهم حتى يتحدد حق الزيارة
toProve.en: The existence of minor children and who holds their custody, so that visitation can be fixed

factsToState.ar: أسماء الأولاد وتواريخ ميلادهم ومن يمارس الحضانة ومكان ممارستها
factsToState.en: The children's names and birth dates, who exercises custody and where

proof.means: family record and children's birth extracts

note.en: Supporting documents named in the petition.

text.ar: الحكم بالطلاق بين المدعي والمدعى عليها (...) بإرادة الزوج.
text.en: A judgment of divorce between the plaintiff and the defendant (...) at the husband's will.

text.ar: تمكين المدعي من حق زيارة الأولاد (...) وفق ما يحدده القاضي.
text.en: Allowing the plaintiff visitation rights over the children (...) as the judge fixes.

message.ar: المادة 423 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ينظر قسم شؤون الأسرة في دعاوى الزواج وانحلال الرابطة الزوجية وتوابعها. والمادة 32: في المحكمة التي لم تنشأ فيها الأقسام ينظر القسم المدني. القسم المختار يختلف عن القسم المقترح؛ تحقق من أقسام المحكمة.
message.en: CPCA article 423: the family section hears claims on marriage, its dissolution and its consequences; article 32: in a court without sections the civil section hears the case. The section chosen differs from the one proposed; check the court's sections.

rule.ar: دعوى الطلاق أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرتها مسكن الزوجية دون سواها؛ وتقدم حضانة الأولاد وزيارتهم حيث تمارس الحضانة (القاعدة في الوحدة المستوردة).
rule.en: A divorce claim goes to the court of the marital home and no other; custody and visitation of the children go where custody is exercised (the rule of the imported unit).

rule.ar: الدفع بعدم الاختصاص الإقليمي يثار قبل أي دفاع في الموضوع؛ ولا نص مقروء يبيح للمحكمة إثارته تلقائيا.
rule.en: The plea of territorial incompetence is raised before any defence on the merits; no text read lets the court raise it of its own motion.

name.ar: مستخرج من سجل الحالة المدنية لعقد الزواج
name.en: Extract of the civil-status register for the marriage

why.ar: الزواج يثبت بمستخرج من سجل الحالة المدنية (المادة 22 من قانون الأسرة).
why.en: Marriage is proved by a civil-status extract (family code article 22).

why.ar: عند عدم تسجيل الزواج يثبت بحكم قضائي (المادة 22 من قانون الأسرة).
why.en: Where the marriage is not registered it is proved by a judgment (family code article 22).

name.ar: نسخ من العريضة بعدد الأطراف ونسخة للنيابة العامة
name.en: Copies of the petition for each party and one for the public prosecutor

why.ar: تودع العريضة بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف، وتبلغ نسخة منها رسميا إلى المدعى عليها وإلى النيابة العامة (المادتان 14 و438 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية)؛ ويراعى أجل عشرين يوما بين التكليف بالحضور والجلسة الأولى، وثلاثة أشهر إن كانت مقيمة بالخارج (المادة 16).
why.en: The petition is lodged in as many copies as there are parties and a copy is formally served on the defendant and the public prosecutor (CPCA articles 14 and 438); at least twenty days must separate the summons and the first hearing, three months if she lives abroad (article 16).

name.ar: الشهادة العائلية ومستخرجات عقود ميلاد الأولاد
name.en: Family record and the children's birth extracts

why.ar: وثائق مؤيدة للطلب المتعلق بزيارة الأولاد تذكر في العريضة (المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية).
why.en: Supporting documents for the visitation request, named in the petition (CPCA article 15).

why.ar: لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا (المادة 17 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية).
why.en: The petition is registered only after the fees fixed by law are paid (CPCA article 17).

looksLike.en: A divorce claim by the husband

tellingFacts.ar: الطلب هو التطليق لسبب من الأسباب المحددة أو الخلع بمقابل مالي
tellingFacts.en: The request is tatliq on one of the listed causes, or khul for a payment

message.ar: المادتان 53 و54 من قانون الأسرة: التطليق والخلع من حق الزوجة، وليسا طلبا بإرادة الزوج. تحقق من صفة رافع الدعوى ونوع الطلب.
message.en: Family code articles 53 and 54: tatliq and khul belong to the wife and are not a divorce at the husband's will. Check who is the plaintiff and the kind of request.

tellingFacts.ar: الزواج غير مسجل في سجل الحالة المدنية
tellingFacts.en: The marriage is not registered in the civil-status register

message.ar: المادة 22 من قانون الأسرة: الزواج غير المسجل يثبت بحكم قضائي، والمادة 423 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: دعاوى إثبات الزواج من اختصاص قسم شؤون الأسرة. تحقق من وجود حكم بإثبات الزواج.
message.en: Family code article 22: an unregistered marriage is proved by a judgment, and CPCA article 423: claims to prove a marriage go to the family section. Check whether a judgment proving the marriage exists.

tellingFacts.ar: صدر بين الطرفين حكم بالطلاق سابق
tellingFacts.en: A divorce judgment has already been given between the parties

message.ar: المادة 49 من قانون الأسرة: لا يثبت الطلاق إلا بحكم، والمادة 50: من راجع زوجته بعد الحكم بالطلاق يحتاج إلى عقد جديد. تحقق من قيام الزواج وقت رفع الدعوى.
message.en: Family code article 49: divorce is established only by judgment, and article 50: a man who takes back his wife after the judgment needs a new contract. Check that the marriage subsists on the day of filing.

tellingFacts.ar: توجد بين الزوجين دعوى طلاق أو تطليق أو خلع قائمة لم يفصل فيها
tellingFacts.en: A divorce, tatliq or khul action between the spouses is pending and undecided

message.ar: المواد 53 و54 و55 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: وحدة الموضوع والارتباط تجيزان للجهة القضائية الأخيرة أن تتخلى لصالح الأولى. تحقق من الدعوى القائمة وجهتها.
message.en: CPCA articles 53, 54 and 55: unity of subject and connexity allow the later court to give up the case in favour of the earlier one. Check the pending action and the court seised.

looksLike.en: A divorce at the husband's will

tellingFacts.ar: الزوجان متفقان على الطلاق وعلى توابعه ويقدمان عريضة واحدة موقعة منهما
tellingFacts.en: Both spouses agree on the divorce and its consequences and lodge a single petition signed by both

message.ar: المادة 427 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: الطلاق بالتراضي إجراء مستقل بإرادة الزوجين المشتركة.
message.en: CPCA article 427: divorce by mutual consent is a separate procedure by the spouses' joint will.

looksLike.ar: طلاق بإرادة الزوج مع طلب التعويض
looksLike.en: A divorce at the husband's will with a request for compensation

tellingFacts.ar: الطلب مبني على نشوز أحد الزوجين ويرمي إلى التعويض للطرف المتضرر
tellingFacts.en: The request rests on the recalcitrance of a spouse and seeks compensation for the injured party

message.ar: المادة 55 من قانون الأسرة: عند نشوز أحد الزوجين يحكم القاضي بالطلاق وبالتعويض للطرف المتضرر.
message.en: Family code article 55: on the recalcitrance of a spouse the judge pronounces divorce and awards compensation to the injured party.

question.ar: هل للزوجين أولاد قصر من هذا الزواج؟
question.en: Do the spouses have minor children of this marriage?

proposedSlots.why: Request r2, element e3 and document doc4 read it: visitation can be asked for only if there are children, and the judge fixes it with custody (the rule on custody and visitation).

examples.title: Clean case: a registered marriage, children, no pending action.
Near miss: the wife asks for khul, not the husband.
The marriage was never registered: proof by judgment needed.
A divorce judgment already exists between the parties.
The wife already has a tatliq action pending.
Nothing known: the rules ask for the facts they read.
The court has no family section: the civil section hears it.

question.ar: ما المقصود بمسكن الزوجية إذا غادرته الزوجة أو افترق الزوجان؟
question.en: What is the marital home when the wife has left it or the spouses live apart?

why.ar: النصوص تحدد الاختصاص بمسكن الزوجية دون تعريفه، وتجعل الدفع بعدم الاختصاص الإقليمي قبل أي دفاع في الموضوع.
why.en: The texts fix jurisdiction by the marital home without defining it, and require the territorial plea before any defence on the merits.

reading.en: The last home the spouses shared.

reading.ar: المسكن الذي تقيم فيه الزوجة الآن.
reading.en: The home where the wife now lives.

protectiveReading.ar: يتحقق المحامي من آخر مسكن مشترك ومن موطن المدعى عليها ويختار المحكمة التي لا يرد عليها الدفع.
protectiveReading.en: The lawyer checks the last shared home and the defendant's domicile and chooses the court against which the plea is least likely.

question.ar: هل تشترط الشهادة العائلية ومستخرجات الميلاد في دعوى الطلاق بإرادة الزوج؟
question.en: Are the family record and birth extracts required in a divorce at the husband's will?

why.ar: المادة 429 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية تشترط الشهادة العائلية وعدد الأولاد القصر في عريضة الطلاق بالتراضي وحدها.
why.en: CPCA article 429 requires the family record and the number of minor children in the mutual-consent petition only.

reading.en: The requirement is specific to mutual consent.

reading.ar: الوثائق مفيدة في كل طلاق لتحديد الأولاد والحضانة.
reading.en: The documents are useful in every divorce to identify the children and custody.

protectiveReading.ar: تدرج الوثائق عند الحاجة إلى طلب الزيارة، دون اعتبارها شرط قبول.
protectiveReading.en: The documents are listed when visitation is asked, not treated as a condition of admissibility.

question.ar: ما أثر إغفال محضر الصلح أو تجاوز مدة الأشهر الثلاثة؟
question.en: What follows if the conciliation record is omitted or the three months are exceeded?

why.ar: النصوص تقرر الواجب والمدة ولا تذكر جزاء.
why.en: The texts state the duty and the period and no sanction.

reading.ar: الواجب على القاضي ولا أثر له على قبول عريضة المدعي.
reading.en: The duty is the judge's and does not affect the admissibility of the plaintiff's petition.

protectiveReading.ar: لا تضع القاعدة حجبا ولا تحذيرا للمحامي عن هذه المدة.
protectiveReading.en: The record writes neither a block nor a warning for the lawyer on this period.

question.ar: هل دعوى التطليق أو الخلع القائمة للزوجة هي نفس النزاع (وحدة الموضوع) أم ارتباط فقط؟
question.en: Is a wife's pending tatliq or khul action the same dispute (unity of subject) or only connected?

why.ar: المادة 53 تشترط نفس النزاع أمام جهتين مختصتين من نفس الدرجة، والمادة 55 تكتفي بوجود علاقة.
why.en: Article 53 requires the same dispute before two competent courts of the same degree; article 55 needs only a relation.

protectiveReading.ar: تنبيه المحامي إلى الدعوى القائمة دون استنتاج أثرها.
protectiveReading.en: Warn the lawyer of the pending action without concluding its effect.

question.ar: هل كانت مواد قانون الأسرة المذكورة نافذة بصيغتها الحالية وقت الزواج أو الوقائع؟
question.en: Were the family code articles cited in force in their present wording at the date of the marriage or the facts?

why.ar: ملاحظة المخزن تقول إن النص الحالي فقط متحقق منه ولا تثبت قابلية انطباقه على قضية أقدم.
why.en: The store's note says only the current text is checked and does not certify its applicability to an earlier case.

protectiveReading.ar: تعامل كل الأحكام على أنها النص الحالي وتترك التحقق التاريخي للمحامي.
protectiveReading.en: Treat every statement as the current text and leave historical checking to the lawyer.

question.ar: ما المعيار الذي يتحقق به تعسف الزوج في الطلاق، وهل تطلب الزوجة التعويض أم يحكم به القاضي؟
question.en: By what test is the husband's abuse of divorce found, and does the wife have to ask or may the judge award compensation unasked?

why.ar: المادة 52 لا تعرف التعسف ولا تذكر إن كان الحكم بالتعويض مشروطا بطلب.
why.en: Article 52 neither defines abuse nor says whether the award needs a request.

reading.ar: يحكم به القاضي إذا تبين له التعسف دون طلب.
reading.en: The judge awards it on finding abuse, unasked.

protectiveReading.ar: يعلم المحامي موكله بالتعرض للتعويض دون أن تعد القاعدة ذلك استنتاجا.
protectiveReading.en: The lawyer informs the client of the exposure to compensation; the record does not draw the conclusion.
